code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Restore rectangular frames and fill their interiors with the paired seed color.
    frames=[(1,3,1,12,4),(2,10,2,6,8),(3,9,11,22,4)]
    for frame,r0,c0,r1,c1,fill in frames:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): out[r][c]=frame
                elif (r-r0+c-c0)%2==0: out[r][c]=fill
    return out
'''
